# `ew sql`

3 subcommand path(s). The synopsis lists the flags; `ew help` prints the positional arguments too.

## `ew sql`

```text
ew sql [--project <project>] [--file <file>] [--format <format>] [--json] [--timeout <timeout>] [--out <out>]
```

Stability: preview.

| Flag | Takes a value | Repeatable |
|---|---|---|
| `--project` | yes | no |
| `--file` | yes | no |
| `--format` | yes | no |
| `--json` | no | no |
| `--timeout` | yes | no |
| `--out` | yes | no |

**Exit codes**

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success |
| 2 | usage, open and SQL errors, denials and limits |

**Result** (`--json`): `ew.sql-result/1`, schema [`ew.sql-result-1.schema.json`](https://github.com/Ironkode787/ElektraWatt/blob/main/bin/ew/schemas/ew.sql-result-1.schema.json).

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | `"ew.sql-result/1"` | yes |  | The name of this schema. |
| `columns` | array of string | yes |  | The column names, as the statement names them (duplicates allowed). |
| `rows` | array of array of [`SqlCell`](#sqlcell) | yes |  | The rows, each with one value per column. |

### SqlCell

One value of a `SqlResult` row: numbers stay numbers, `NULL` is `null`, a blob is its `x'…'` text, a real
that is not finite is `null`.

One of the following forms:

1. **Form 1**: `NULL`.

   Shape: `null`

2. **Form 2**: An integer.

   Shape: integer (format `int64`)

3. **Form 3**: A floating-point number.

   Shape: number (format `double`)

4. **Form 4**: Text (or a blob as `x'…'`).

   Shape: string
